items.title: The Innermost Loop — Feb 20: Gemini 3.1 Pro SOTA, UAP Disclosure Forced by AI Curve, Fusion Licensing
items.summary: Google launched Gemini 3.1 Pro with new SOTA scores: 44.4% on HLE (no tools), 77.1% on ARC-AGI-2, and 94.3% on GPQA Diamond — crowned the new Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index leader at less than half the cost of Opus 4.6 or GPT-5.2. The White House directed agencies to begin releasing UFO/UAP files, with growing recognition that disclosure was 'forced by the AI curve.' Arc Institute's MULTI-evolve achieved 10-fold improvements in protein directed evolution with a single ML round. SoftBank is forming a consortium for a 9.2 GW gas plant ($33B) — the largest in the US — to power data centers. Type One Energy submitted a fusion stellarator licensing application targeting a 2029 prototype.
items.source: The Innermost Loop — Dr. Alex Wissner-Gross
items.relevance: Gemini 3.1 Pro at half the cost of Opus 4.6 with better benchmarks is the key signal — cost compression continues accelerating. For KodaAI, this means the model powering your agents gets cheaper every month. The freelancer displacement stat ($1 human → $0.03 AI) validates the entire AI-agent-as-service thesis.

items.title: Seedance 2.0: China's AI Video Model Spooks Hollywood
items.summary: ByteDance released Seedance 2.0, one of the most advanced AI video generation models yet. CNN reports it's drawn praise for ease of use and the realistic nature of videos it generates in minutes. Hollywood is reportedly concerned about the implications for content production costs and timelines.
items.relevance: Video generation quality is hitting an inflection point. For any content creation in AVA or KodaAI marketing, AI-generated video is becoming viable for demos, explainers, and social content at near-zero cost.

items.title: Eversense 365 + twiist AID System Now Fully Available in the US
items.summary: Senseonics and Sequel Med Tech announced full US availability of the twiist Automated Insulin Delivery system integrated with the Eversense 365 CGM — the first AID system compatible with an implantable 365-day CGM sensor. This eliminates the need for frequent sensor changes entirely, a major quality-of-life improvement for Type 1 diabetes management.
items.relevance: A full-year implantable CGM with automated insulin delivery is a game-changer for T1D. AVA Type 1 should support Eversense data integration — users on this system will want app support. The 365-day sensor removes the biggest friction point in CGM adoption.

items.title: CGM Market to Hit $49.3B by 2036 — 10.6% CAGR
items.summary: New market research projects the glucose monitoring device market will grow from $17.9B in 2026 to $49.3B by 2036 at 10.6% CAGR. Growth driven by expanding CGM use beyond traditional diabetes into gestational diabetes, prediabetes wellness monitoring, and metabolic health optimization.
items.relevance: Nearly 3x market growth in 10 years confirms CGM is going mainstream. AVA Type 1 is positioned in a rapidly expanding market — the addressable user base will roughly triple by 2036. This is investor-deck material.

items.title: Claude Sonnet 4.6 Released — Now Default for Free & Pro Users
items.summary: Anthropic released Claude Sonnet 4.6 on Feb 17, now the default model for all free and Pro users on claude.ai. Key improvements: better computer use, coding, design, knowledge work, and large data processing. 1M token context window. Fewer hallucinations compared to predecessor. Priced same as Sonnet 4.5. Follows Opus 4.6 release earlier this month. Wikipedia notes agent teams and Claude in PowerPoint were also part of the 4.6 launch.
items.relevance: You're running on Opus 4.6 right now. Sonnet 4.6 being the new default means the free tier just got significantly better — useful for any public-facing AVA features where you want to minimize API costs. The agent teams feature could be huge for multi-agent workflows.

items.title: Kimi K2.5 + Kimi Code CLI — Open-Source Claude Code Competitor
items.summary: Moonshot AI's Kimi K2.5 launched with Kimi Code, an open-source terminal-first coding agent that directly competes with Claude Code and Gemini CLI. Features include autonomous coding, IDE integration for VSCode/Cursor/Zed, and 100 parallel agents. The multimodal model can convert screen recordings to code. Ranked #4 in LogRocket's Feb 2026 AI dev tool power rankings.
items.relevance: An open-source Claude Code alternative is worth trying — especially the video-to-code feature. If it can clone websites from screen recordings, that's a workflow game-changer for rapid prototyping. Free access available.

items.title: Former GitHub CEO Launches 'Entire' — $60M Seed to Rebuild Dev Workflows for AI Agents
items.summary: Thomas Dohmke launched Entire with the largest-ever dev tools seed round ($60M from Felicis, Madrona, Microsoft M12). Core thesis: Git tracks what changed but not why. AI agents generate reasoning that disappears when sessions end. First product is an open-source Git-aware CLI that captures AI agent context during development.
items.relevance: This solves a real pain point — when Claude Code makes changes, the reasoning behind decisions doesn't survive in git history. Worth watching for the first release. At $60M seed, investors clearly see dev tooling for agent workflows as a massive gap.
